title: Modal verbs 7: had to / was able to / managed to
note: a2_could_able gave past ability COULD. This is the rest: had to for past obligation (must has no past), and was able to / managed to for a single occasion that succeeded, where could does not work. Czech musel jsem -> *I must yesterday. Czech podarilo se mi is the managed to slot. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: Modal verbs 7: had to / was able to / managed to
cards.title_cz: Modální slovesa 7: had to / was able to / managed to
points: These are the **modal verbs** you already know, in the past.
**must** has no past form at all. It borrows **had to**.

examples.cz: Podařilo se jí skončit před šestou.

cards.title: The three past forms
points: **managed to** adds the idea that it took effort.

rows: you were obliged to do it
you could, and on this occasion you did
it was hard, and you did it

cards.title: could, or was able to?
points: For a **single** success, **could** is wrong. Use was able to or managed to.

rows: I **could** swim when I was six.
I **was able** to swim to the boat.
I **managed to** swim to the boat.
one occasion, and it was hard

cards.title: Negatives and questions
points: **didn't have** to means it was not necessary — not that it was forbidden.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: **must** cannot go in the past. Say **had to**.

rows: I **managed to** pass the exam yesterday.

blocks.title: Modal verbs 7: had to / was able to / managed to

items.en: I had to work last Saturday.
accepts: I had to work last Saturday.
items.explanation: **must** has no past. The past of must is **had to**.
items.explanation_cz: **must** nemá minulý čas. Minulý čas od must je **had to**.

items.en: She managed to finish before six.
items.cz: Podařilo se jí skončit před šestou.
accepts: She managed to finish before six.
items.explanation: One occasion, and it was an effort: **managed to** finish.
items.explanation_cz: Jedna příležitost a stálo to úsilí: **managed to** finish.

items.en: We weren't able to open the door.
items.gap: We ____ to open the door. (not / be able)
accepts: We weren't able to open the door.
We were not able to open the door.
items.wrong: We didn't able to open the door.
items.explanation: **be able to** keeps the be verb: weren't **able to**.
items.explanation_cz: **be able to** si drží sloveso be: weren't **able to**.

items.en: Did you have to wait long?
accepts: Did you have to wait long?
items.explanation: Questions with **have to** use **did**: Did you have to wait.
items.explanation_cz: Otázky s **have to** používají **did**: Did you have to wait.

items.en: I didn't have to pay for the ticket.
items.gap: I ____ pay for the ticket. (not / have to)
accepts: I didn't have to pay for the ticket.
I did not have to pay for the ticket.
items.explanation: **didn't have to** = it was not necessary. **mustn't** would mean it was forbidden.
items.explanation_cz: **didn't have to** = nebylo to nutné. **mustn't** by znamenalo, že to bylo zakázáno.

items.en: He was able to fix the car himself.
items.gap: He ____ fix the car himself. (be able)
accepts: He was able to fix the car himself.
items.explanation: **he** takes **was able to**, one job that he completed.
items.explanation_cz: **he** má **was able to**, jedna věc, kterou dotáhl.

items.explanation: Past obligation for **they**: had to leave.
items.explanation_cz: Minulá povinnost pro **they**: had to leave.

items.en: I managed to get a ticket at the last minute.
items.cz: Na poslední chvíli se mi podařilo sehnat lístek.
items.gap: I ____ get a ticket at the last minute. (manage)
accepts: I managed to get a ticket at the last minute.
items.explanation: It was difficult and it worked: **managed to** get.
items.explanation_cz: Bylo to těžké a povedlo se: **managed to** get.

items.en: She had to take the bus because her car broke down.
items.cz: Musela jet autobusem, protože se jí porouchalo auto.
accepts: She had to take the bus because her car broke down.
items.wrong: She must take the bus because her car broke down.

items.en: We were able to find a hotel near the station.
items.cz: Podařilo se nám najít hotel blízko nádraží.
items.gap: We ____ find a hotel near the station. (be able)
accepts: We were able to find a hotel near the station.
items.explanation: **we** takes **were able to** for a single search that succeeded.
items.explanation_cz: **we** má **were able to** pro jedno hledání, které vyšlo.
